title: After the Church Rock spill
text: After the 1979 Church Rock uranium spill, the Navajo Nation asked New Mexico's governor to request disaster assistance. New Mexico's governor refused. Residents were warned by radio and by signs written in English, though many Navajo people speak only Diné Bizaad. The site was added to the Superfund national priorities list in 1983.
